content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has updated its guidelines to include specific recommendations for children and adolescents. These guidelines now advise the use of A1C testing, fasting plasma glucose (FPG) testing, or 2-hour plasma glucose (PG) testing to screen for diabetes in this younger population. Although these tests were initially developed and implemented for adults, they are now considered appropriate and effective for use in children and adolescents as well.
